# Roam China

Roam China is a practical travel planner for international visitors planning trips to China. It focuses on destination playbooks, day-by-day itineraries, regional Chinese food, local transport, mobile payments, travel apps, ticket checkpoints, and clearly labeled display advertising.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://cntripaimap.online/): Overview of China travel planning resources.
- [China destinations](https://cntripaimap.online/destinations): City and region guides for Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Chengdu, Guilin, Hangzhou, Hong Kong, and Zhangjiajie.
- [China itineraries](https://cntripaimap.online/itineraries): Curated travel routes including classic first-time trips, nature routes, Silk Road travel, and Guangzhou food travel.
- [Chinese cuisines](https://cntripaimap.online/cuisines): Regional cuisine guide covering major culinary traditions and signature dishes.
- [Travel guides](https://cntripaimap.online/guides): Practical articles for first-time visitors, mobile payments, apps, high-speed rail, entry preparation, eSIM setup, budgets, hotels, transport, and food.
- [China travel tools](https://cntripaimap.online/travel-tools): Pre-trip decision paths for entry checks, eSIM setup, payments, high-speed rail, budgets, and hotel areas.
- [About Roam China](https://cntripaimap.online/about): Editorial mission, standards, and revenue disclosure.
- [Contact](https://cntripaimap.online/contact): Corrections, advertising inquiries, and general feedback.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cntripaimap.online/privacy-policy): Cookies, Google advertising, analytics, and contact details.
- [Advertising Policy](https://cntripaimap.online/advertising-policy): Ad labeling, editorial independence, and placement standards.

## Useful Deep Links

- [Beijing travel guide](https://cntripaimap.online/destination/beijing): Imperial sights, Great Wall planning, and Peking duck.
- [Shanghai travel guide](https://cntripaimap.online/destination/shanghai): Bund, Lujiazui, gardens, and xiaolongbao.
- [Chengdu travel guide](https://cntripaimap.online/destination/chengdu): Panda base, teahouses, Sichuan food, and relaxed city travel.
- [Classic 14-day China itinerary](https://cntripaimap.online/itinerary/classic-14-days): Beijing, Xi'an, Chengdu, and Shanghai.
- [China travel tools](https://cntripaimap.online/travel-tools): Planning checklist that links entry, connectivity, payments, rail, budgets, and stay areas.
- [Chinese travel apps guide](https://cntripaimap.online/guide/g2): Alipay, WeChat, Didi, maps, translation, and connectivity.
- [Food travel guide to China](https://cntripaimap.online/guide/g3): Regional cuisines, ordering advice, and dining etiquette.
- [China high-speed rail guide](https://cntripaimap.online/guide/g4): 12306 booking, passport checks, station choice, seat classes, and transfer timing.
- [China entry checklist](https://cntripaimap.online/guide/g5): Visa-free transit checks, passports, official source verification, and arrival setup.
- [China internet and eSIM guide](https://cntripaimap.online/guide/g6): Mobile data, roaming, hotel Wi-Fi, translation backups, and connectivity planning.
- [China travel budget guide](https://cntripaimap.online/guide/g7): Hotels, transport, food, attractions, payment backups, and where costs rise.
- [Where to stay in China](https://cntripaimap.online/guide/g8): Hotel areas for Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, and Guilin with first-night logistics.

## Editorial Notes

- Audience: English-speaking international travelers visiting China.
- Tone: practical, direct, and planning-oriented.
- Content emphasis: answer common pre-trip questions clearly, avoid keyword stuffing, and keep itinerary advice actionable.
- Advertising: ad units should remain clearly labeled and separated from navigation, share, save, download, and booking-style controls.
